## Purpose

Describe the problem, the proposed change, and why it belongs in this project.

## Scientific effect

- [ ] No empirical result, threshold, timing rule, or claim boundary changes.
- [ ] Any empirical change has an approved prospective protocol and versioned outputs.
- [ ] Synthetic checks are labeled and are not presented as empirical evidence.

## Verification

- [ ] `make quality` passes.
- [ ] Relevant tests pass and new behavior has regression coverage.
- [ ] Artifact and public-export manifests are updated where required.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, blueprint, or restricted source artifact is exposed.
- [ ] Documentation, decisions, and deviations are synchronized with the change.

## Evidence

List the tests, audit records, manifests, and issue numbers that support this change.
